name: Punctured-Triangle Cap Contraction Obstructions
definition: Let $X=\{a,b,c\}\mathbin{\dot\cup}W$ with $|W|\ge2$, and let $\mathcal L_\triangle=\{\{a\},\{b\},\{a,b\},\{a,c\},\{b,c\},\{a,b,c\}\}$. For $\epsilon\in\{b,c\}$ put $A_\epsilon=\{a,\epsilon\}$ and delete $\mathcal L_\triangle\cup\{A_\epsilon\cup S:S\subseteq W\}$ from $2^X$. Attach a new pendant coordinate $f$ at the empty endpoint of the resulting base.
parameters: $d=|X|\ge5$, $|W|\ge2$, and $\epsilon\in\{b,c\}$. The pendant family has $2^d-2^{|W|}-4$ states.
canonical_form: The two variants cap one of the two punctured-triangle edges incident with $a$; exchanging the local labels accounts for their evident symmetries.
recognition: A construction certificate verifies a valid base root ($\{c\}$ for $\epsilon=c$, or $\{a,b,c,w\}$ for any $w\in W$ when $\epsilon=b$), the exact holes at $\varnothing$ and $X$, and repair sets $\{a,b,c\}$ and $W$.
comments: Every member is contraction-minimal outside learning-space graphs. No pc-minimality or completeness claim is made because learning-space graphs are not closed under convex restrictions.
